$comment: Per-frame ceilings for the docs library world, checked by scripts/perf.mjs (`just perf`, and CI on pull requests). draws counts a frame's draw calls without shadow passes and shadowDraws one shadow pass's: shadow maps redraw on a timer, so a per-frame total would move with the frame rate. Counts are about 15% over the higher of what main measures on a GPU and in CI's software renderer, so a regression shows up before it ships. Lower them when cost comes down; raise one only with a reason in the PR. minFps is enforced only with --timing (a real GPU).
